scope: Deploy typed request-local thinking budget to an existing local benchmark/router path; qualify enforcement and one-task Go outcomes while preserving model and global controls.

controls.reasoning_effort: max except explicit low-unset regression control
controls.cache: unchanged policy; uncontrolled state, no resets

custody: Same selected model/process/image/recipe, unchanged route/defaults/cache. One owned C1 job; native waiting zero and running at most two under existing C4; complete owned HTTP accounting and worker exit before the next job. User traffic preserved.

criteria.enforcement: Actual routed budget reaches native engine; one forced-close boundary near8192 followed by answer, or mark forced behavior unobserved. Delimiter overhead is not an exact thinking-token ceiling.
criteria.quality: Independent pinned Go starter/reference grader; retain every failure. No broad quality or speedup claim.
criteria.unset_regression: Low effort without numeric budget accepted with existing shape, produces answer independently checked.
criteria.safety: Stop submissions on identity/admission/transport/cgroup/OOM failures. No rollback. Ordinary coding failure retained and continue frozen safe controls. No unchanged rerun until pass.

exclusions: No model restart/replacement or settings/cache change
No secondary activation or fleet acceptance

preflight.scope: Router code regression, separately labeled from the three Go jobs

controller_scope: deferred: current legacy activation-observer profile would refuse after candidate upgrade; preserving held fleet/observer owner. Do not claim remote-controller budget support.

authority.deployment: User explicitly requested deploying the reviewed patch into the existing setup
authority.mutation_scope: Local CLI selectors and image-only router successor with identical configuration bytes; preserve current model/controller/observer/startup owners
authority.recovery: fix forward under current selected model; no rollback
authority.traffic: Managed whole-router ingress barrier for replacement; never cancel unrelated work; separate native UNKNOWN-memory acknowledgement retained

readiness: Selected historical oracle image is requalified by each fresh worker before generation; no same-ID standalone prepare step. Current strict Python environment independently verified before deployment.
